release_notes: Build 112 makes Autopilot choose each generated quiz category from the same YouTube Performance recommendation plan shown in the app instead of carrying forward the Builder's General Knowledge selection.
Each batch slot now applies its recommended category before questions are selected, so category changes are deterministic rather than depending on a background polling race.
The growth plan continues to balance proven performers with rotation and experiment slots while the channel is still learning what audiences prefer.
A queued Winner follow-up can still reserve the first full-video slot; later slots return to the performance-driven plan automatically.
If no performance slot is available, Autopilot preserves the current Builder category as a fallback rather than forcing General Knowledge.
The old competing growth-category polling handler has been removed so Performance is the single source of truth for normal Autopilot generation.
Regression tests verify that a performance recommendation overrides a General Knowledge Builder default and that multi-category plans advance correctly.
Build 111 website inventory sync and Build 110 Create and Advanced cleanup remain included unchanged.
